content.text: "Run primary-publication.js with input {\"entry_id\":\"2LYZ\"} (or another four-character PDB entry). Uses only credential-free public reads on data.rcsb.org and api.crossref.org. RCSB rcsb_primary_citation explicitly identifies the primary publication; citation id must be primary. Crossref /works/{doi}, discovered from https://api.crossref.org/swagger-docs, must classify the matching DOI as journal-article, not dataset. Checks normalized title, year, volume, and pages. Returns exact Crossref title array and publisher; throws on missing or inconsistent evidence. Verified by execution for 2LYZ: DOI 10.1016/0022-2836(74)90598-1; title [\"Real-space refinement of the structure of hen egg-white lysozyme\"]; publisher Elsevier BV. All bibliographic checks passed. Also previously verified for 1CRN. Reusable parameterised implementation retained in primary-publication.js."

args.content: Run primary-publication.js with input {"entry_id":"1UBQ"} or another four-character PDB identifier. Performs credential-free GET reads only on data.rcsb.org/graphql and api.crossref.org/works/{doi}. RCSB rcsb_primary_citation and id=primary establish the primary publication association; Crossref must return the same DOI as a journal-article (not dataset). Checks title, publication year, volume and page range. Title comparison uses Unicode NFKD with combining marks removed, accommodating RCSB A versus Crossref Å; output preserves the exact Crossref title array. Throws on missing identifiers or failed checks. Verified by execution for 1UBQ: DOI 10.1016/0022-2836(87)90679-6; title ["Structure of ubiquitin refined at 1.8 Å resolution"]; publisher Elsevier BV. Both sources agree on 1987, volume 194, pages 531-544. Saved implementation was executed successfully after repair of Unicode title normalization. Earlier saved documentation records verification for 1CRN and 2LYZ.
